title: External-reproduction guide + verify >=1 independent re-run
context: M3 reproducibility verification for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Provides a step-by-step external re-run guide and confirms at least one independent party reproduces a matching run within documented tolerance. Independent reproduction is a primary success outcome (O-series) and the strongest evidence the benchmark is trustworthy. Operates on open/simulated inputs only.
objective: Write the external-reproduction guide and verify >=1 independent re-run matches within documented tolerance, logging any discrepancies.
acceptanceCriteria: Step-by-step external re-run guide; >=1 independent party confirms a matching run (within documented tolerance); discrepancies logged.
Guide references pinned container digests, reference build, and provenance so a third party can reproduce from scratch.
output: docs/reproduction-guide.md — external-reproduction guide + independent re-run verification log.
